actions_description_chk.name: actions_description_chk
actions_description_chk.value: description IS NULL OR length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000

actions_due_date_chk.name: actions_due_date_chk
actions_due_date_chk.value: due_date IS NULL OR (length(due_date)=10 AND due_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(due_date, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(due_date, '+0 days')=due_date)

actions_waiting_type_chk.name: actions_waiting_type_chk
actions_waiting_type_chk.value: waiting_type IS NULL OR waiting_type IN ('client', 'ellen', 'ary', 'team', 'external', 'dependency', 'other')

actions_waiting_chk.name: actions_waiting_chk
actions_waiting_chk.value: (status='waiting' AND waiting_type IS NOT NULL AND waiting_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(waiting_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR (status<>'waiting' AND waiting_type IS NULL AND waiting_reason IS NULL)

actions_completion_chk.name: actions_completion_chk
actions_completion_chk.value: (status='done' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'done' AND completed_at IS NULL)

assets_name_chk.name: assets_name_chk
assets_name_chk.value: length(trim(filename)) BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND instr(filename, char(0))=0 AND instr(filename, char(10))=0 AND instr(filename, char(13))=0 AND instr(filename, '/')=0 AND instr(filename, char(92))=0

assets_mime_chk.name: assets_mime_chk
assets_mime_chk.value: length(mime_type) BETWEEN 3 AND 127 AND instr(mime_type, '/')>1 AND instr(mime_type, char(10))=0 AND instr(mime_type, char(13))=0

assets_ready_chk.name: assets_ready_chk
assets_ready_chk.value: (status='ready' AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND etag IS NOT NULL) OR (status='archived') OR (status IN ('uploading','failed') AND ready_at IS NULL AND etag IS NULL)

assets_archive_chk.name: assets_archive_chk
assets_archive_chk.value: (status='archived' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'archived' AND archived_at IS NULL)

assets_lease_chk.name: assets_lease_chk
assets_lease_chk.value: (status='uploading' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'uploading' AND lease_until IS NULL)

content_approval_rounds_number_chk.name: content_approval_rounds_number_chk
content_approval_rounds_number_chk.value: typeof(number)='integer' AND number>=1 AND typeof(request_revision)='integer' AND request_revision>=1

content_approval_rounds_feedback_chk.name: content_approval_rounds_feedback_chk
content_approval_rounds_feedback_chk.value: feedback IS NULL OR length(trim(feedback)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

content_approval_rounds_reason_chk.name: content_approval_rounds_reason_chk
content_approval_rounds_reason_chk.value: withdrawal_reason IS NULL OR length(trim(withdrawal_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

content_approval_rounds_resolution_chk.name: content_approval_rounds_resolution_chk
content_approval_rounds_resolution_chk.value:
(status='requested' AND responded_by IS NULL AND responded_at IS NULL AND feedback IS NULL AND withdrawn_by IS NULL AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND withdrawal_reason IS NULL AND completion_revision IS NULL AND completion_id IS NULL)
    OR (completion_revision>=request_revision+1 AND completion_id IS NOT NULL AND ((status IN ('approved','changes_requested') AND responded_by IS NOT NULL AND responded_at IS NOT NULL AND withdrawn_by IS NULL AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND withdrawal_reason IS NULL AND ((status='approved' AND feedback IS NULL) OR (status='changes_requested' AND feedback IS NOT NULL)))
    OR (status='withdrawn' AND withdrawn_by IS NOT NULL AND withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL AND responded_by IS NULL AND responded_at IS NULL AND feedback IS NULL)))

content_items_stage_context_chk.name: content_items_stage_context_chk
content_items_stage_context_chk.value: stage_context IS NULL OR (stage IN ('waiting_for_recording','revision_requested') AND length(trim(stage_context)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

content_items_pillar_chk.name: content_items_pillar_chk
content_items_pillar_chk.value: pillar IS NULL OR length(trim(pillar)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

content_items_hook_chk.name: content_items_hook_chk
content_items_hook_chk.value: hook IS NULL OR length(trim(hook)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

content_items_script_chk.name: content_items_script_chk
content_items_script_chk.value: script IS NULL OR length(trim(script)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000

content_items_caption_chk.name: content_items_caption_chk
content_items_caption_chk.value: caption IS NULL OR length(trim(caption)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000

content_items_cta_chk.name: content_items_cta_chk
content_items_cta_chk.value: cta IS NULL OR length(trim(cta)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

content_items_target_chk.name: content_items_target_chk
content_items_target_chk.value: target_publish_date IS NULL OR (length(target_publish_date)=10 AND target_publish_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(target_publish_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(target_publish_date,'+0 days')=target_publish_date)

content_items_published_chk.name: content_items_published_chk
content_items_published_chk.value: (stage='published' AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR (stage<>'published' AND published_at IS NULL)

deliverables_label_chk.name: deliverables_label_chk
deliverables_label_chk.value: client_label IS NULL OR length(trim(client_label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

deliverables_description_chk.name: deliverables_description_chk
deliverables_description_chk.value: description IS NULL OR length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000

deliverables_target_date_chk.name: deliverables_target_date_chk
deliverables_target_date_chk.value: target_date IS NULL OR (length(target_date)=10 AND target_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(target_date, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(target_date, '+0 days')=target_date)

deliverables_delivery_chk.name: deliverables_delivery_chk
deliverables_delivery_chk.value: (status='delivered' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NULL)

milestones_label_chk.name: milestones_label_chk
milestones_label_chk.value: client_label IS NULL OR length(trim(client_label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

milestones_start_date_chk.name: milestones_start_date_chk
milestones_start_date_chk.value: start_date IS NULL OR (length(start_date)=10 AND start_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(start_date, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(start_date, '+0 days')=start_date)

milestones_target_date_chk.name: milestones_target_date_chk
milestones_target_date_chk.value: target_date IS NULL OR (length(target_date)=10 AND target_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(target_date, '+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(target_date, '+0 days')=target_date)

milestones_dates_chk.name: milestones_dates_chk
milestones_dates_chk.value: start_date IS NULL OR target_date IS NULL OR target_date >= start_date

milestones_completion_chk.name: milestones_completion_chk
milestones_completion_chk.value: (status='completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status<>'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL)

milestones_waiting_chk.name: milestones_waiting_chk
milestones_waiting_chk.value: (status='waiting' AND waiting_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(waiting_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR (status<>'waiting' AND waiting_reason IS NULL)

projects_label_chk.name: projects_label_chk
projects_label_chk.value: client_label IS NULL OR length(trim(client_label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

projects_department_source_chk.name: projects_department_source_chk
projects_department_source_chk.value: service_engagement_id IS NULL OR department_id IS NULL

projects_dates_chk.name: projects_dates_chk
projects_dates_chk.value: start_date IS NULL OR target_date IS NULL OR target_date >= start_date

projects_completion_chk.name: projects_completion_chk
projects_completion_chk.value: (status <> 'completed' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL OR status IN ('completed','archived'))

projects_reason_chk.name: projects_reason_chk
projects_reason_chk.value: (status IN ('waiting','blocked') AND status_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(status_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR (status NOT IN ('waiting','blocked') AND status_reason IS NULL)
